title: Extreme
source: generated (Nestris Puzzle Analysis project): diverse set of likely extremely hard puzzles
notes: Not in nestris.org's database (never played). rating/theme/current_k/next_k/score_k from an exact port of the site's rating code and pinned StackRabbit; current/next = the answer (engine move 1). predicted_solve_rate_5star and chance_extreme_5star are model estimates for 5-star-level players. At most one puzzle per board and no two puzzles that play nearly alike. Every answer is also nestris.org's in-browser StackRabbit answer (query <board>|18|0|<cur>|<next>|X.|343|3|30|, nextBox[0]); no board identical to a nestris.org puzzle and none playing nearly like a site 4-5 star puzzle.
